events.label: Woman makes Damien Shanklin allegations public

slots.name: final sentence
slots.sentence: A Title IX case on matter initially resulted in Shanklin being found responsible for "forcible rape" and suspended one year, but an appeal reduced the suspension to probation, according to ESPN.

slots.name: date allegations public
slots.sentence: After the Title IX investigation was appealed by Shanklin and resulted in a lesser sentence, the woman went public.
